snippet.title: Valiant Tactics - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Valiant Tactics is a turn-based roguelite RPG without hit chance RNG. As a loyal knight, you will assemble a team of fearless heroes, grow their power, arm them with mighty artifacts, then confront and defeat the usurper who killed your king and restore the kingdom!

Buy Valiant Tactics now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2412280/Valiant_Tactics/

Follow us:
Discord: https://discord.gg/Bzg8uN3wb6
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Valiant_Tactics
